# SQL Injection Payloads - InsightFlow Security Test Fixtures
# Format: one payload per line, # for comments

# Basic SQL injection
' OR 1=1 --
' OR '1'='1
' OR 1=1; --
' OR '1'='1' --

# Admin login bypass
admin' --
admin' #
admin'--
' OR 1=1 --
' OR '1'='1' --
' OR 1=1;#
admin' OR '1'='1
admin' OR 1=1--

# Union-based injection
' UNION SELECT NULL --
' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL --
' UNION SELECT NULL,NULL,NULL --
' UNION SELECT username,password FROM users --
' UNION SELECT * FROM information_schema.tables --
' UNION SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='users' --
' UNION SELECT 1,@@version,3 --
' UNION ALL SELECT NULL,NULL,NULL --

# Blind SQL injection
' AND 1=1 --
' AND 1=2 --
' AND SLEEP(5) --
' AND BENCHMARK(5000000,MD5('test')) --
' AND (SELECT * FROM users WHERE user_id=1)=1 --
' OR IF(1=1,SLEEP(5),0) --
' OR pg_sleep(5) --
' WAITFOR DELAY '0:0:5' --

# Stacked queries
'; DROP TABLE users; --
'; DELETE FROM sessions; --
'; INSERT INTO users VALUES('hacker','password'); --
'; UPDATE users SET role='admin' WHERE user_id=1; --
'; CREATE TABLE hack(data TEXT); --
'; EXEC xp_cmdshell('dir'); --

# Error-based injection
' AND EXTRACTVALUE(1,CONCAT(0x7e,(SELECT @@version))) --
' AND UPDATEXML(1,CONCAT(0x7e,(SELECT @@version)),1) --
' OR 1 GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING 1=1 --
' AND 1=CONVERT(int,(SELECT @@version)) --

# Time-based injection (PostgreSQL)
' OR (SELECT CASE WHEN (1=1) THEN pg_sleep(5) ELSE pg_sleep(0) END) --
' OR (SELECT CASE WHEN (1=2) THEN pg_sleep(5) ELSE pg_sleep(0) END) --
' ; SELECT pg_sleep(5) --

# PostgreSQL-specific
' OR current_setting('password') IS NOT NULL OR '1'='1
' ; SELECT * FROM pg_stat_activity --
' UNION SELECT datname,0,0 FROM pg_database --
' UNION SELECT usename,passwd,0 FROM pg_shadow --
' UNION SELECT table_name,NULL,NULL FROM information_schema.tables --

# MySQL-specific
' UNION SELECT @@datadir,@@hostname,@@version --
' UNION SELECT load_file('/etc/passwd'),NULL,NULL --
' INTO OUTFILE '/tmp/evil.txt' FIELDS TERMINATED BY ',' --

# MSSQL-specific
' UNION SELECT @@SERVERNAME,@@VERSION,DB_NAME() --
' ; EXEC sp_configure 'show advanced options',1; RECONFIGURE; EXEC sp_configure 'xp_cmdshell',1; RECONFIGURE; --
' ; EXEC xp_cmdshell 'whoami' --
' UNION SELECT name,master.dbo.fn_varbintohexstr(password_hash),NULL FROM sys.sql_logins --

# SQLite-specific
' UNION SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master --
' UNION SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' --
' UNION SELECT group_concat(name) FROM sqlite_master --

# NoSQL injection (MongoDB)
' || '1'=='1
' || 1==1
' && this.password.match(/.*/) --
{"$ne": null}
{"$gt": ""}
{"$regex": ".*"}
{"$where": "1==1"}
admin' || 1==1//
